summary: Sesi 17 verification: backend probe scripts/probe_sesi17.py ALL PASS (categories PATCH cascade+lock, convert-to-so 409 under lock, outbound-from-order concurrent single-set, leads CRUD+convert, manager inbox APIs). Frontend mobile flows tested at 390x800 with kn_force_mobile='1'. Sales leads (create/list/convert) WORK end-to-end. Manager MobileOpsApp inbox WORKS for reject price approval (reason dialog + confirm-modal-confirm). CRITICAL BUG found: clicking any notification in Notifikasi tab crashes the React tree with pageerror 'o is not a function' — screen goes blank, root div empty, does NOT jump to Persetujuan tab as intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking any mo-notif-ntf_* item throws pageerror 'o is not a function' (minified). Body becomes empty, MobileShell unmounts, mo-inbox never renders. Notifikasi → Persetujuan jump is broken. Regression blocking the notif→inbox UX advertised in the sesi17 spec.

integration_issues.issue: setTab('queue') path in NotifPanel.open() likely crashes downstream (unhandled error post axios.post /notifications/{id}/read or during MobileApprovalInbox remount). No console log, only pageerror. Same MobileApprovalInbox renders fine on initial default-tab mount, so the crash is triggered on the re-mount path after the read POST.

action_items: Investigate NotifPanel.open() → setTab('queue') crash. Suspected: unhandled promise from POST /api/notifications/{id}/read (maybe response shape) or MobileApprovalInbox render on incomplete price-approval row (e.g., normal_price null → NaN in formatCurrency/Math.round). Add try/catch around setTab logic and defensive checks in MobileApprovalInbox render (guard p.normal_price / p.requested_price).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileApprovalInbox.jsx line 35: Math.round(((p.normal_price - p.requested_price) / (p.normal_price || 1)) * 100) — if normal_price is missing this yields NaN but formatCurrency(undefined) may throw depending on impl. Add nullish guards.

MobileOpsApp.jsx NotifPanel.open(): setTab('queue') is called even when the POST /notifications/{id}/read fails silently; no error boundary wraps tab renderers so a downstream throw takes down the whole shell.
Consider wrapping MobileShell main content in an ErrorBoundary so a broken tab doesn't blank the app.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 pending price_approval (SESI17UI tag) via tests/sesi17_fixtures.py create; cleaned after test (delete_many by reason regex SESI17UI). Sales lead + converted customer also cleaned.
